comment: NuGet packages allowed in the shipped projects (src/). Checked by build/check-licenses.ps1. Add a package here only after reviewing its license.
license: the package's SPDX license expression, which must equal the <license type="expression"> in its .nuspec.
licenseUrl: only for legacy packages whose .nuspec has no license expression; must equal its <licenseUrl> exactly. license then records what the reviewer found at that URL.

buildOnly: used at build time only. Enforced: the package must contribute no runtime, native, resource or content files to any shipped project (per obj/project.assets.json), so nothing from it can reach the packed .xll.

packages.notes: Excel-DNA build tasks and native .xll loader; the loader is part of the packed .xll.
Excel-DNA runtime library, embedded in the packed .xll.

Excel formula parser for Trace In (Core). Shipped unmodified in the packed .xll; MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft, so THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md says where its source is. Any change to XLParser's own files must be published under MPL-2.0.
Parser framework XLParser is built on; transitive. Shipped in the packed .xll.
Reference assemblies so net48 builds without Visual Studio (developmentDependency).
Implicit reference for the netstandard2.0 Core library; .NET Framework 4.8 supplies netstandard at run time.
Transitive via NETStandard.Library; contains only the runtime identifier graph (runtime.json), no assemblies.
